dialogues.speaker: Parsley
dialogues.text: Hold firm! Drag another wardrobe over here! Ugh...!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Vile beasts! The Immernachtreich shall not tolerate such a transgression...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: You arrive at a most opportune time, vassal. Sword at the ready!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Fear not. The foul monsters have been cast into the void.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein means to say that you should refrain from going out for the time being. We will continue to protect this area.

dialogues.speaker: Parsley
dialogues.text: Thank you! Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Parsley
dialogues.text: But, um... I've never seen a bird that can, uh... talk, heh...

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Ah, no need to worry. I'm mein Fräulein's humble servant. Please rest assured, I'm not a danger to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can trust them. I promise.

dialogues.speaker: Parsley
dialogues.text: Oh, no. Of course! I didn't mean it that way at all. I just, uh, misspoke...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: My vassals have unfinished duties, yes? Then, go forth and smite these wretched beasts. The Prinzessin's blessing shall illuminate your path!
